article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-dominant hybrid
Genetics: OG Kush × LA Confidential
Breeder: Southern California
THC Content: 20–27%
CBD Content: Low (<1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Limonene , Caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Earthy pine, lemon fuel, herbal spice
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Early to mid-October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Few cannabis strains carry a name that evokes the grandeur of European royalty, yet King Louis XIII does exactly that. The name suggests luxury and strength, and in many ways the cultivar reflects those qualities through its potent effects and classic kush aroma. Within dispensaries and cultivation circles, the strain is often associated with heavy relaxation and deeply soothing body effects, characteristics that have made it a staple among indica enthusiasts.

The plant emerged from California’s rich cannabis culture during a period when OG Kush genetics were rapidly shaping modern breeding programs. Growers searching for cultivars with strong potency and unmistakable kush flavor gravitated toward this hybrid because of its ability to deliver both. Over time, it became one of the more recognizable OG-derived strains available, valued for its powerful body effects and its distinct pine-forward terpene profile.
Genetics and Lineage

The lineage of King Louis XIII combines two influential cannabis strains that helped define West Coast marijuana genetics . The hybrid results from a cross between OG Kush and LA Confidential, both widely respected for their potency and rich terpene expression.

OG Kush serves as one of the foundational pillars of modern cannabis breeding. Its genetics have influenced countless hybrids due to its distinctive aroma and strong psychoactive effects. The strain typically expresses terpenes that create a blend of lemon citrus, pine, and earthy fuel-like notes. These traits are clearly visible in King Louis XIII, particularly in the citrus brightness and dense resin production inherited from the OG lineage.

LA Confidential contributes additional indica strength to the genetic profile. Known for its deeply relaxing body effects and dense trichome-coated buds, this strain adds a calming physical dimension that balances the more cerebral qualities of OG Kush. When these two genetic lines combine, the resulting hybrid produces a cultivar that emphasizes powerful body relaxation while maintaining the aromatic complexity associated with OG strains.
Effects and Experience

The experience produced by King Louis XIII often begins with a gentle wave of mental calm. Shortly after consumption, many users notice a sense of emotional ease and quiet euphoria. The early stage of the high tends to soften stress without creating overwhelming stimulation, allowing the mind to settle into a peaceful rhythm.

As the session progresses, the physical component of the high gradually intensifies. Muscles begin to loosen and a soothing heaviness spreads through the limbs. This stage reflects the strong indica influence inherited from both parent strains. The body effect often feels warm and grounding, encouraging relaxation and stillness.

Eventually the high settles into a deeply tranquil state. Many cannabis consumers find that the strain encourages restful activities such as watching movies, listening to music, or preparing for sleep. Because the experience leans strongly toward physical relaxation, the cultivar is most often enjoyed during evening hours.
Medical Benefits

Medical marijuana patients frequently explore King Louis XIII for its strong relaxing properties. The terpene composition plays an important role in shaping these effects. Myrcene, one of the dominant terpenes present in the strain, is widely associated with sedative qualities and muscle relaxation.

Individuals coping with chronic stress or anxiety may find the hybrid helpful for promoting a calmer mental state. The gentle euphoria that appears early in the experience can reduce emotional tension while encouraging a sense of mental quiet. Unlike highly stimulating cannabis varieties, this strain tends to guide the mind toward rest rather than activity.

Physical discomfort is another area where the cultivar may offer therapeutic value. The body-heavy effects can ease muscle tightness and minor aches while encouraging relaxation. Some medical cannabis users also report improvements in sleep quality and appetite when the strain is consumed in the evening.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aromatic signature of King Louis XIII strongly reflects its OG heritage. When the buds are broken apart, the scent released into the air often resembles fresh pine needles mixed with earthy kush and subtle citrus peel. Beneath these dominant aromas lies a faint skunky undertone that adds depth to the fragrance.

Flavor develops gradually during consumption. The inhale typically introduces a strong pine character that resembles forest resin. As the smoke or vapor spreads across the palate, lemon citrus and herbal spice begin to appear. The exhale often leaves behind a mild diesel-like note that lingers briefly.

This complex flavor profile arises from a terpene composition dominated by myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. Myrcene contributes the earthy base and relaxing body effects, while limonene introduces citrus brightness. Caryophyllene adds subtle peppery spice that enhances the flavor’s overall depth.
Growing Information

Cultivating King Louis XIII generally falls into the moderate difficulty range. The plant inherits sturdy growth characteristics from its OG Kush lineage, producing strong stems capable of supporting dense buds. Indoor growers often observe compact plants with thick foliage and relatively short internodal spacing.

Flowering typically completes within eight to nine weeks indoors. As the plant approaches maturity, the buds swell and develop thick layers of resin. Trichome coverage often becomes extremely heavy during the final stages of flowering , giving the flowers a frosted appearance.

Outdoor cultivation performs best in warm climates with consistent sunlight. Under favorable conditions , plants can produce generous yields of dense buds with bright orange pistils and vibrant green coloration. Proper airflow is important because the thick flowers may retain moisture in humid environments.
FAQ
What strain is King Louis XIII? King Louis XIII is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain created by crossing OG Kush with LA Confidential.
Is King Louis XIII indica or sativa? The strain is primarily indica-dominant, producing strong body relaxation and calming mental effects.
How strong is King Louis XIII? THC levels typically range between 22% and 28%, making it a potent cannabis cultivar depending on cultivation quality.
What does King Louis XIII taste like? The flavor profile combines pine resin with lemon citrus, earthy spice, and mild diesel undertones.
Is King Louis XIII good for sleep? Many cannabis users prefer this strain during evening hours because its relaxing effects may encourage restful sleep.
Final Thoughts on King Louis XIII

King Louis XIII represents a classic example of OG-based cannabis breeding . By combining OG Kush with LA Confidential, growers created a hybrid that emphasizes the most desirable qualities of both parent strains. The result is a cultivar capable of delivering rich terpene expression alongside powerful body relaxation.

For recreational weed enthusiasts, the strain offers an experience that transitions smoothly from mild euphoria to deep physical calm. Its pine-forward aroma and earthy citrus flavor provide a sensory profile that feels both traditional and distinctive.

From a cultivation perspective, the plant remains popular among growers due to its dense buds and heavy resin production. Reliable potency and strong kush fragrance ensure that the strain continues to hold a respected place within the broader family of OG cannabis genetics.
